svg.aria-label: Two schematic elevations of one slab raised on pilotis, with a section between them: the north-north-west face a grid of deep horizontal louvres between vertical fins, the south face plain glass with no shading, and the section showing louvres standing off one face and glass on the other.
svg.text: THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND HEALTH, RIO DE JANEIRO · ONE SLAB, TWO FAÇADES
NORTH-NORTH-WEST
THE SUN-FACING FAÇADE
SOUTH
THE OPPOSITE FAÇADE
SECTION
NNW
S
DEEP LOUVRES ON HAND LEVERS,
TURNED BY THE OFFICE WORKERS
FULLY GLAZED AND UNSHADED
BOTH FAÇADES STAND ON PILOTIS, RAISED AT NIEMEYER'S SUGGESTION INTO A SHADED PUBLIC GROUND
WHAT THE DESIGNER WROTE · COSTA'S PROJECT MEMOIR, 1939
IN SUBSTANCE: BECAUSE THIS METHOD OF SUN PROTECTION HAD NOT BEEN TESTED,
THE TYPE TO BE USED WOULD NEED CAREFUL STUDY.
WHAT THE ONE TECHNICAL STUDY FOUND · A SIMULATION, 2008
FOR MOST OF THE SUMMER MONTHS THE LOUVRES RECEIVE NO DIRECT SUN ON THAT FAÇADE.
SO THERE THEY ARE NOT JUSTIFIED AS SOLAR PROTECTION, AND THEIR DARK COLOUR DEGRADES THE DAYLIGHT.
AS FAR AS TWO INDEPENDENT SEARCHES ESTABLISH, THE LOUVRES HAVE NEVER BEEN FIELD-TESTED THERE.
SCHEMATIC ELEVATIONS AND SECTION, NOT TO SCALE; STOREYS AND BAYS NOT COUNTED
MOMA 82483 · ALMODÓVAR MELENDO, CABEZA LAINEZ AND JIMÉNEZ VERDEJO 2008
